gen-gf-unkempt-gf-ysabeau-sc: Unkempt has a rough, hand-cut swagger with no thick-thin contrast at all, and its t keeps crossbar and stem matched. Ysabeau SC moves along quietly beneath it, gently modern.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-zen-kaku-gothic-antiqu: Unkempt wears its bold, hand-made attitude openly, with a crossbar and stem on the t that match in weight. Zen Kaku Gothic Antique follows in a smooth, clean sans-serif, so long paragraphs would flow without a snag.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-zen-kaku-gothic-new: Unkempt is loud and expressive, with gaps that keep each c distinct from an o. Zen Kaku Gothic New gives it a counterweight of open curves and no hairlines or swells anywhere, which makes the whole pair feel approachable.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-jaldi: Stenciled, tall and commanding, Wallpoet leaves thin lines of paper showing between its letters. Yet Jaldi, a sans-serif with a lifted x-height and a visibly gaping c, brings a professional, approachable ease that is the pair's real strength.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-menbere: Menbere stacks its lowercase tall, like rolled cord, and reads clean and neutral. Menbere as a sans-serif body would carry a long page without fuss, while Wallpoet above it stays bold and stenciled.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-narnoor: Narnoor keeps its ascenders short above big bowls, which gives it a professional, level-headed look. Yet Wallpoet's tall, stenciled lowercase and commanding gaps give the pair its strongest quality: a loud top and a quiet base.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-winky-sans: Wallpoet cuts thin gaps of paper right through its tall, bold lowercase, and it commands attention. And Winky Sans, with capitals barely taller than its lowercase, keeps things modern and quiet, which is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-gf-wallpoet-outfit: Wallpoet is stenciled and tall, built for a bold statement with its paper-showing gaps. And Outfit, bent like cable with curves that stop short of closing, does the quiet work of being friendly and clean.
gen-gf-wallpoet-space-grotesk: Commanding and stenciled, Wallpoet tops the pair with tall lowercase. Space Grotesk answers in a sans-serif ribbon of constant width, and that flat, unvarying line against the heading's low contrast is the strongest quality here.
gen-gf-warnes-fs-chillax: Stretched, spacious and inky, Warnes tapers its strokes out before they touch, with no contrast at all. Warnes does the loud, expressive work, while Chillax, a relaxed sans-serif with unfinished loops, handles the easy reading.
